mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 82 degrees at the Verona Area High School. If you are a night owl, you can catch the ISS passing low on the horizon from Middleton toward Fitchburg at 3:31 AM. Overnight, expect a low of 69 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona recently unveiled the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park. Commissioned by Gerri Gurman and crafted by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland, this seven-foot sculpture made from a reclaimed ash tree celebrates traditional Tai Chi movements and aims to inspire future generations of local artists.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the lineup includes the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, live music at Paddy Mac's, and trivia nights at both The Bogey Factory and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In a noteworthy call for service on August 30, officers discovered a vehicle versus bicyclist crash at East Verona Avenue and Lincoln Street. The 15-year-old bicyclist was uninjured, while the driver was cited for failing to yield the right of way.
Today is the perfect day to stop by Culver's for the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:00 PM tonight.
